scope_note: This is the 1979 first-edition work identity and must not be silently replaced by the substantially revised 2024 second edition.
statement: Beck, Rush, Shaw, and Emery published 'Cognitive Therapy of Depression' with Guilford Press in 1979.
statement_zh: Beck、Rush、Shaw 與 Emery 於 1979 年由 Guilford Press 出版《Cognitive Therapy of Depression》。
